reviewer: Root integrating agent; actual author technical review
summary: Current author review of the connected developer workflow contract; local implementation and native-client acceptance remain distinct.

properties.statement: A fresh adopted project with its required runtime, guidance and mapped records reports session readiness without an active work item or any subprocess/account call.
properties.preconditions: Fresh source and adopted fixture projects.
properties.verification: Run doctor before selection, mutate a required package input and require a precise failing readiness result without writes.

properties.statement: Required behavioral statements recognize each supported EARS form while malformed statements prevent structured acceptance.
properties.preconditions: Ubiquitous, event, state, unwanted, optional and combined statement fixtures.
properties.verification: Run explicit valid and malformed requirement fixtures; verify syntax is never labeled semantic proof.

properties.statement: Only current structurally valid sourced analysis is recorded, and an unresolved blocker continues to prevent acceptance after its original snapshot becomes stale.
properties.preconditions: Actual response identity and recorded review source; stale/malformed/blocking variants.
properties.verification: Mutate contract, context, response and source notes; reject stale import and retain blocker until a current resolution is recorded.

properties.statement: Every required behavioral ID has an observable property with a suitable strategy and resolvable task/check coverage before task-plan acceptance.
properties.preconditions: Current requirements and design with a completed task graph.
properties.verification: Exercise partial/proposed mappings during design and require complete actual mapping at task acceptance.

properties.statement: Configured eligible tasks execute by dependency wave with bounded attempts/time and verified integrated results; failures never become ready.
properties.preconditions: Clean committed temporary Git fixture, trusted checks and explicit fake author.
properties.verification: Exercise independent/overlapping tasks, failing checks, surviving children, slow Git hooks and interrupted outcomes.

properties.statement: The original application remains unchanged until an exact verified candidate is explicitly applied; collisions or changed state cannot silently overwrite user work.
properties.preconditions: Candidate and original identities plus ignored-file and Git-hook variants.
properties.verification: Compare original bytes/head before apply; reject ignored rename destinations and changed original; preserve and report post-merge divergence.

properties.statement: A current reconciliation preview reopens affected conclusions and completion while preserving history and still-valid unrelated outcomes.
properties.preconditions: Changed contract/source/context and an exact preview fingerprint.
properties.verification: Exercise stale preview refusal, source/decision-only rewind, sibling preservation and ordinary write-failure rollback.

properties.statement: A complete installed package preserves application authority and provides working public entry commands; missing required source or package files remain visible.
properties.preconditions: New and existing temporary applications, mappings and uncommitted user files.
properties.verification: Run bootstrap and actual installed CLI flows, preservation/rerun and missing-runtime/guidance cases.

properties.statement: A delivered source claim identifies current tested/reviewed input identities and every published file matches the expected remote tree.
properties.preconditions: Frozen combined candidate and actual publication readback.
properties.verification: Record the real aggregate run and fresh review, reconcile changed historical claims, compare remote paths/modes/blob hashes and expected head.

properties.statement: Any native workflow equivalence claim is backed by actual selected-client consultation, task execution, changed-contract and resume observations under approved limits.
properties.preconditions: Separate approved frozen pilot with real configured client; no AWS account access.
properties.verification: Execute the prepared native pilot after manual approval, record every invocation/outcome and review its frozen rubric; retain NOT RUN until observed.
